entries.title: Connect Notion, Linear and other MCP servers that ask you to sign in
entries.body: Settings → Integrations now connects an MCP server at a web address that asks for a sign-in. Press Notion or Linear beside the MCP server chip, or add any server's address, and its sign-in page opens in your browser. Once you finish there, the server's tools appear in its row. Infinitary keeps the sign-in in Secrets and renews it on its own; when the service ends it, the row offers Sign in again. Removing the server signs it out there too. A server that only works with an app of your own says so, since Infinitary does not offer that yet.
